name: Seppa
description: District headquarters of East Kameng, situated on the banks of the Kameng River in a scenic valley. Serves as the main gateway and base for exploring nearby valleys, hill stations and tribal villages of the Nyishi community.
facts: Helipad in the heart of town; connected by road to Tezpur and Itanagar

name: Bameng Valley
description: Scenic highland valley and hill-station-like area about 48 km north of Seppa, surrounded by misty mountains, paddy fields and forests. Known for traditional Nyishi villages and panoramic views, including of snow peaks.
facts: Cooler climate like a hill station

name: Chayangtajo
description: Picturesque hilltop town and administrative circle about 81 km from Seppa, famous for views of the snow-peaked Gorichaan (Gori Chen) mountain. Source area of the Kameng River with terraced fields and Nyishi/Puroik culture.
facts: About 81 km from Seppa via road
Famous for Gorichaan snow peak views

name: Pappu Valley (Lumdung)
description: One of the three scenic valleys of East Kameng, with the meandering Pappu River, green paddy fields on both banks, and migratory birds in winter at Lumdung. Located about 21 km from Seppa under Seppa Block.
facts: Part of the official Three Valleys
Famous for migratory birds in winter
Green with natural beauty in summer

name: Kameng River (Seppa section)
description: Major river flowing through East Kameng, known for angling and fishing in winter (permit required) and scenic riverside views near Seppa. Originates near Chayangtajo and offers potential for adventure activities.
facts: Good for angling in winter with district permission
Scenic meanders and canyons in the district

name: Khenewa Valley
description: Verdant highland valley near Bameng and Chayangtajo, featuring misty hills, scenic river views, open spaces and traditional settlements. Popular for photography and quiet exploration of Nyishi landscapes.

name: Lada
description: Remote mountain settlement in East Kameng embraced by forests, steep hills and babbling brooks. Offers peace, privacy and traditional tribal experiences away from main routes.

name: Gorichaan (Gori Chen) Viewpoint
description: Snow-peaked mountain group (Gori Chen / Gorichaan) visible from Chayangtajo and Bameng in East Kameng. The high Himalayan massif is a prominent landmark for the district's northern views.
facts: Part of the Gori Chen group in the Eastern Himalayas
